name: singlet_feature_selection_batch_aware_selection_for_integration
title: Select batch-aware shared genes for integration
description: Chooses one gene set shared by all batches before integration. It scores each gene inside every batch and combines the batch results; the default is a binomial deviance against per-batch null models with automatic consensus. It needs a batch column, raw counts for count methods or log-normalised values for dispersion methods, and writes selection flags, batch counts, ranks and scores without integrating cells. Do not use it on single-batch data or for clustering-only gene selection; use singlet_feature_selection_highly_variable_gene_selection for that.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: Per-batch statistic. The default is the model-based deviance; other values are published implementations kept as comparators.

batch_key.description: obs column defining batches; must have at least two levels.

selection_scope.description: pooled ranks all cells together as a baseline; per_batch_consensus combines batches; per_lineage repeats that within each lineage.

consensus_rule.description: How batch results combine; auto applies the rule published for the chosen method.

n_features.description: Number of genes in the shared set after consensus.

lineage_key.description: obs column of coarse lineage labels; required when selection_scope is per_lineage.

scvi.description: Options for scvi_poisson_zeros only: Binomial samples per gene and cells per minibatch.

n_samples.description: Binomial samples per gene for the zero-enrichment posterior.

minibatch_size.description: Cells per minibatch for the zero-enrichment statistics.

seed.description: Random seed for sampling in scvi_poisson_zeros; other methods are deterministic.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. var/hvg_batch_selected. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary for completed runs: method, consensus_rule, n_genes_selected, n_batches, n_lineages, score_at_K, top_genes (first 20), warnings. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
